source: Who's On First (whosonfirst-data-admin-us latest dist, downloaded 2026-10-29): placetype neighbourhood (Zetashapes, Quattroshapes) plus placetype locality (cities, towns and census places, Quattroshapes; the City of Miami itself left out) as the coarser fallback, the smallest outline winning; current, polygon geometries whose label point is inside Miami-Dade County (config/metro-bounds/miami.json); none from OpenStreetMap; business zones folded into the neighbourhood dancers name (Wynwood Art District and Miami Fashion District -> Wynwood, Club Row -> Park West, Art Deco Historic District -> South Beach) or left out (Aventura Town Center, Media and Entertainment District, Miami Financial District, Miami Free Zone, Miami Government District, Miami Jewelry District, Miami Riverwalk, Performing Arts District); simplified to about 10 m; WOF's Medley outline left out (it covers eastern Doral, CityPlace Doral included, and misses most of the town of Medley, 2026-10-29)
